100 Years Ago Today, This is What Was Happening ...

On August 26, 1926, a major political shift occurred in Great Britain as Prime Minister Stanley Baldwin announced a new general election aimed at solidifying the Conservative Party's power. In the United States, a severe drought continued to devastate agriculture in the Midwest, prompting concerns over food prices and crop yields. Meanwhile, the League of Nations faced challenges in addressing global disarmament, as tensions remained high in Europe.
